subject: infra.energy
name: Electricity supply for digital infrastructure
what_would_settle_it: a utility annual report or tariff schedule, an electricity-project implementation status report, or a commissioning record for any of the planned mini-grids

subject: infra.capacity
name: Technical capacity, workforce and skills
what_would_settle_it: an ICT workforce or skills assessment, a regulator or ministry capacity audit, or an operating record for the university digital training centre listed as delivered in 2023

subject: gov.protect
name: National cybersecurity strategy, response team and operations centre
what_would_settle_it: the promulgated cybersecurity law text, an agency establishment decree, or a national cybersecurity strategy

subject: data.open
name: National open government data portal or catalogue
what_would_settle_it: a government open-data portal with a dated dataset listing, or the data governance policy the public finances plan names and does not price

subject: dpi.exchange
name: Government interoperability or data-exchange layer
what_would_settle_it: a decree or agency framework creating a government service bus or interoperability standard

subject: dpi.mis
name: Sector management information systems
what_would_settle_it: a health-ministry or education-ministry deployment record, or a contract award or donor project document for any sector system

subject: data.statistics
name: Independent measurement of internet penetration
what_would_settle_it: a regulator statistical bulletin, a statistics-institute survey module, or an operator-reported subscriber series filed with the regulator

subject: data.satellite
name: Earth-observation or satellite data
what_would_settle_it: any earth-observation agreement, geospatial data platform, national mapping programme or satellite-imagery procurement

subject: digital.localgov
name: Local-government digital systems
what_would_settle_it: any commune-level platform, local revenue system, or territorial-administration programme document for the councils elected in December 2025

subject: tech.ai
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: National AI policy, strategy or regulation
what_would_settle_it: a published national AI strategy, a decree or bill on automated decision-making, or a continental AI-strategy accession instrument naming the country

subject: tech.ai
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: AI system deployed in state service delivery
what_would_settle_it: a procurement notice, contract, pilot announcement or ministry statement naming a deployed system and a vendor

subject: tech.innovate
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: Startup funding, accelerator cohort or ecosystem figure
what_would_settle_it: a funding-round announcement, an incubator cohort list, or a tracker country figure

subject: tech.industry
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: ICT sector size, revenue, employment or operator financials
what_would_settle_it: a regulator annual report or observatory, a national-accounts ICT line, or operator segment disclosure

subject: geopol.india
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: India-linked technology activity
what_would_settle_it: a training-centre record, an export-bank line of credit for digital infrastructure, or an Indian vendor contract

subject: capacity.literacy
name: Digital literacy programme
what_would_settle_it: any dated ministry, regulator or donor document naming a digital-literacy programme with a scope or a budget line

subject: capacity.training
name: Digital skills or training programme
what_would_settle_it: a named programme primary with enrolment or funding figures, or a regional programme project document once signed

subject: capacity.research
name: Research capacity
what_would_settle_it: a university, statistics-institute or donor research document

subject: finance.budget
name: Enacted appropriation for any year
what_would_settle_it: a text-extractable copy of any of the three enacted finance laws, at line grain

subject: finance.budget
name: Budget outturn at any grain
what_would_settle_it: a text-extractable quarterly execution report, or a settlement law later than 2019
